data.description: 【军官浴室·熄灯后的蒸汽】卸下一切军衔的深夜，蕾娜穿着深蓝真丝吊带睡裙泡在温热的浴缸边缘。水汽把真丝浸得半透，紧贴着丰盈的曲线，深蓝布料下的粉色樱点若隐若现。她仰头靠在缸沿，银白长发垂进水中，一只手在水面之下缓缓地抚过最敏感的花瓣，潮红的脸颊与失神的轻喘在蒸汽里化开——只有此刻，她允许自己不再是少校。
data.lighting: 浴室壁灯暖光穿透氤氲水汽，湿透真丝泛出诱惑水光
data.promptProse: Reclining against the rim of a deep bathtub in the steam-fogged officers' bathroom, Vladilena Milize wears her midnight-blue silk nightgown soaked to translucent clinging sheerness. The wet silk reveals the pink outlines of her nipples beneath as water beads roll down her collarbone, her long silver hair trailing into the bath while one hand glides slowly beneath the water's surface between her thighs. Her head tilts back against the rim with a flushed, unfocused expression and trembling parted lips, steam curling through warm lamplight. Sensual solo composition, wet translucent fabric, cinematic lighting, volumetric steam, detailed tile background.
